blocks.html: The details of a column available for an entity's data table view.

types.name: id
types.description: The column's unique identifier (e.g., "display\_id", "customer.email").

types.name: name
types.description: The display name for the column.

types.name: description
types.description: Description of the column.

types.name: field
types.description: The field path to access the data.

types.name: sortable
types.description: Whether the column can be sorted.

types.name: hideable
types.description: Whether the column can be hidden.

types.name: default_visible
types.description: Whether the column is visible by default.

types.name: data_type
types.description: The data type of the column.

types.name: semantic_type
types.description: The semantic type provides additional context about the data.

types.name: context
types.description: Additional context about the column.

types.name: computed
types.description: Information about computed columns.

types.name: metadata
types.description:
Arbitrary per-column configuration consumed by cell renderers (e.g. the
field path a renderer reads, or a value->variant map). Populated from the
settings entity override's `fieldMetadata` (any column) or a computed
column definition's `metadata`.

types.name: relationship
types.description: Information about relationship columns.

types.name: default_order
types.description: Default order for sorting columns.

types.name: category
types.description: Category for grouping columns.

types.name: render_mode
types.description: Render mode hint for the UI to determine how to display this column.

types.name: filter
types.description: Filter configuration for this column.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Whether filtering is enabled for this column.

children.name: relationship
children.description: Relationship filter config for dropdown selection.

children.name: value_field
children.description: Field to use as filter value (e.g., "id").

children.name: filter_key
children.description: Key to use for filtering the relationship. If not provided, the column field is used.

types.name: source
types.description: Source information about where this column comes from.

types.name: custom_label
types.description: Whether this column uses a custom user-defined label.

types.name: label_id
types.description: ID of the PropertyLabel record if custom label is used.
